comment: Version-specific patches for perl 5.24. skip_codegen entries were collected 2026-08-29 from the multi-perl 5.24 downstream leg (the 5.24 leg was missing from the original 0.1.7-era auto-collection; see doc/plan/round-5.20-5.26.md). Re-run tools/build-error-to-vpatches.pl after each perl-headers update or libperl-macrogen change.

patches.name: Perl_atof
patches.reason: The macro lacks aTHX_: Perl_my_atof takes (pTHX_ const char *s) on threaded builds, so the expansion is a 1-arg call to a 2-arg function (E0061). Latent in C because core code calls my_atof (embed.h adds aTHX_). Fixed upstream in 5.36. Same entry as in v5.20/v5.22/v5.32/v5.34.patches.json.
patches.source_loc: perl-5.24 perl.h (#define Perl_atof(s) Perl_my_atof(s) under USE_PERL_ATOF)

patches.name: S_perl_hash_djb2
patches.reason: Internal hash-function inline (hv_func.h) removed/reworked in modern perl. The old implementations use loop macros that reassign their induction variable (E0384 MURMUR_DOBYTES), u8/u32 mixed arithmetic (E0277) and assignment-position casts (E0067) that the codegen does not support. S_-prefixed internal implementation, not public API. Same family as the v5.20/v5.22 entries; verified failing in the 2026-08-29 collection (the 5.24 leg was missing from the original auto-collection).

patches.name: sv_collxfrm
patches.reason: Upstream sv.h bug on this version: `#define sv_collxfrm(sv, nxp) sv_cmp_flags(sv, nxp, SV_GMAGIC)` calls sv_cmp_flags instead of sv_collxfrm_flags, passing STRLEN* where SV* is expected (E0308). Latent in C because core code never calls the short name. Same entry as v5.26; fixed upstream by 5.34.

patches.name: RX_MATCH_UTF8_on
patches.reason: Expands to `RXp_EXTFLAGS(ReANY(prog)) |= / &= flag` where RXp_EXTFLAGS is itself generated as a helper fn, so the compound assignment gets a function call on the left-hand side (E0067 invalid left-hand side of assignment). Write-through accessor support would be a new codegen feature (Signature Approval). Same entry as v5.26; verified failing in the 2026-08-29 collection.

patches.name: RX_ENGINE
patches.reason: struct regexp's `engine` field is `const struct regexp_engine *` (regexp.h), so the generated body yields *const regexp_engine while the inferred return type is *mut regexp_engine (E0308). Const propagation from struct-field reads is a future codegen fix. Same entry as v5.26; verified failing in the 2026-08-29 collection.

patches.name: CX_POP_SAVEARRAY
patches.reason: The 5.24 macro shape passes GvAV's GV argument where the callee expects *const sv without inserting the GV-to-SV cast (E0308 expected *const sv, found *mut gv). Cast-gap residual class (compiles from 5.26 on); candidate for a future codegen fix. Verified failing in the 2026-08-29 collection.

patches.name: MgPV_nolen_const
patches.reason: The generated conditional mixes pointer mutability between branches: the SvPV_nolen_const branch yields *mut c_char while the mg_ptr branch is cast to *const c_char (E0308 types differ in mutability). Cast-gap residual class; candidate for a future codegen fix. Verified failing in the 2026-08-29 collection.

patches.name: S__is_utf8_char_slow
patches.reason: The inline body declares `STRLEN actual_len;` uninitialized and passes &actual_len as an out-param to Perl_utf8n_to_uvchr, so the generated `let mut actual_len: STRLEN;` + `&raw mut actual_len` is rejected by rustc (E0381 used binding isn't initialized). Out-param zero-initialization would be a future codegen fix. Generated only on the non-threaded build of this version (threaded legs do not generate it). Same entry as v5.22; verified failing in the 2026-08-29 collection.

patches.name: RCPV_LEN
patches.reason: RCPV_* does not exist before perl 5.38 (cop.h RCPV refactor), so the common return_type_override has no target here and only emits a MISS warning (dict lookup fails; issue #17). Cancel the common patch on this version.
